metadata.description: A curated collection of useful plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: claude-md
plugins.description: A plugin for managing CLAUDE.md configurations with auto-update detection

plugins.name: socratic-questioning
plugins.description: A plugin that guides Claude to use Socratic questioning methods with multiple choice questions to clarify unclear prompts

plugins.name: darwin
plugins.description: Automatic error-fixing plugin that offloads runtime error resolution to a dedicated agent, saving main conversation context

plugins.name: plan-guardian
plugins.description: Plan review workflow plugin with a plan-reviewer agent for rigorous plan quality checks. Non-blocking by default — Claude autonomously decides when to review, or users trigger via /plan-review. v1.3.0 adds an opt-out codex review gate: a PreToolUse:ExitPlanMode hook intercepts plan-mode exits, instructs Claude to run /plan-guardian:codex-plan-review which loops `codex exec` against the plan and revises it until Codex emits NO_CONCERNS; the hook re-allows the original ExitPlanMode call only after a sha256 sentinel confirms the exact plan converged (set CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW=0 to disable). v1.4.0 adds /plan-guardian:setup to silence the plan-mode permission prompts the codex loop triggers, via scoped allow-rules for ./.plan-review/** (state stays in ./.plan-review/, never the protected .claude/ path).

plugins.name: bug-fix-testcase
plugins.description: End-to-end bug fix workflow with /bugfix command: analyze, research, plan, fix + parallel test generation, merge, and verify

plugins.name: codex-cr-loop
plugins.description: Codex review loop commands: iterate /codex:review until two consecutive clean rounds, with three completion modes (review-only stop, local merge, push + open PR). Always-on interaction-logic guard blocks user-visible UX changes (gestures, dialog/menu types, shortcuts, navigation) until the user explicitly confirms. Final report always ends with a Chinese business-impact summary module: a 3–8 line summary when commits change user-observable behavior, or a single literal line `无业务逻辑影响` for pure refactors. Preflight base-currency gate (v1.5.0) hard-stops the loop (rebase-first / abort) when the feature branch isn't built on top of its base; the base branch is auto-detected (main / master / any default).

plugins.name: form-base
plugins.description: HTML interaction base for Claude Code & Codex: agent-emitted forms (radio/checkbox/text/markdown + color/font/slider), rich-response views (business-prominent, technical-collapsed), and a switchable SessionStart-injected communication role (product-manager default; developer / lawyer / null switchable via /form-base:role). Role shapes answers only, never restricts tool use.
